faqs.q: What size dumpster do I need?
faqs.a: A one-room remodel or a garage cleanout usually fits in a 10 or 15 yard. A full kitchen, flooring for a whole house or a big cleanout is a 20. New construction and whole-house tear-outs run 30 or 40. Tell us the project and we will help you pick.

faqs.q: Will a dumpster damage my driveway?
faqs.a: A loaded roll-off is heavy. We set it down on boards to spread the weight, and it helps to keep it off fresh concrete and away from the edge of the slab. If you are worried about a spot, point it out when we drop it.

faqs.q: What can't go in a dumpster?
faqs.a: Paint, solvents, oil, tires, batteries, appliances with refrigerant, and anything hazardous are generally not allowed. Concrete, dirt and brick can go in, but they are heavy and usually need their own box. Ask when you call if you are not sure.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit in Shreveport?
faqs.a: On your own driveway or lot, generally no. If the dumpster has to sit on a city street or sidewalk, check with the City of Shreveport or Bossier City before it is dropped.

faqs.q: How long can I keep it?
faqs.a: Rentals are set by the number of days, and you can extend if the job runs long. Call when you are done, or when it is full, and it gets picked up.

faqs.q: Can you swap it when it fills up?
faqs.a: Yes. On construction and big cleanout jobs, a full dumpster can be hauled off and an empty one set down in its place.

sections.heading: Pick a flat spot the truck can back straight into.
sections.body: A roll-off truck needs room to back up in a straight line and some clearance overhead. Look up for low limbs and power lines before you pick the spot. Most driveways work fine; the end of the driveway closest to the street is usually easiest.

sections.heading: Heavy on the bottom, flat on top.
sections.body: Put heavy, flat things in first and break down furniture and cabinets so they lie flat. Nothing should stick up over the top edge — an overloaded dumpster cannot be hauled on the road safely.

sections.heading: Check your HOA.
sections.body: Some neighborhoods in Shreveport and Bossier have rules about how long a dumpster can sit in a driveway. If you have an HOA, a quick check before delivery saves a letter later.

faqs.q: Do I have to be home for delivery?
faqs.a: Not usually. Mark the spot, make sure the driveway is clear and the truck can get in, and it can be set down without you there.

sections.heading: Brush you cut on purpose.
sections.body: South Shreveport pines along Ellerbe and out toward Wallace Lake, pecan limbs in the older neighborhoods, a fence line in Bossier, a Haughton lot that grew up in sweetgum. Cut it so it lies flat in the box. Long limbs stacked like pickup sticks waste the space and they hang over the rail, which means the box does not leave. A 15 or a 20 handles most yard piles. A cleared acre is a different phone call.

sections.heading: Stumps, dirt, and a house full of wet carpet are not yard waste.
sections.body: A stump with a root ball is mostly soil. Dirt is a heavy-box load. Wet carpet and drywall after a storm belong on the storm page, because the adjuster may want photos before it disappears. Bagged household trash mixed into the brush is how a clean yard load turns into a mess at the scale. Keep those piles apart and tell us what you actually have.

sections.heading: Do not set it on the septic, and do not hide it under a pine.
sections.body: A lot of these jobs are beside the house, not in a wide commercial lot. Look up. A roll-off truck needs clearance, and Shreveport pines do not care about your plan. If the pile is already on the ground in the back, you will be moving it to the box by the drive. Call 318-225-7589 before you stack it somewhere the truck cannot see. We drop yard-waste dumpsters in Shreveport, Bossier, and the towns around them.

faqs.q: A storm just put a tree on the house.
faqs.a: That is the storm page: photos first, then a box for limbs and whatever came out of the rooms.

faqs.q: There is a bunch of dirt in the pile.
faqs.a: Pull the dirt out and put it in a heavy box. Brush can stay in this one.

faqs.q: Building a house in Benton?
